title: low-prices/<ORIGIN>.json: one origin's low prices, for the explorer
description: Every low price (D24: fresh, within the route's rules, at least meta.detector.low_threshold below a mature typical low) of the latest run from one origin, one per route and trip dates. Compact on purpose: rows are arrays in the order of `cols`, no pretty-print, sorted by departure, return, destination, price, obs. Size budget (D27): at most 160 bytes per row on average and at most site.max_low_prices_per_origin rows (biggest discounts kept; a live promotion's own offer can also be a row), so a file stays under 240 KB raw (~135 bytes per row measured, about 200 KB at the cap; gzip roughly 4x smaller).

run.description: Collection run the rows come from.

cols.description: obs = price_observations.id; dest = destination city code (route = origin-dest); price; dep/ret = departure/return date; found = found_date (traveller) or null; fetched = first fetched by us (UTC, minutes); airline code or null; stops = most stops in either direction (null = unknown); airport = arrival airport or null; typical = the departure month's typical low (routes.json months); link = tracked partner link or null (no button); baggage = checked bag included (true/false) from the GraphQL match, null = unknown (D39, added within v1).

truncated.description: Low prices left out by the row cap (smallest discounts first).
